notes: Reached kavehome.com only through the Claude-in-Chrome connector, in a tab created for this worker; every category page was loaded either by navigating the tab or by same-origin fetch() from the loaded page context. robots.txt (https://kavehome.com/robots.txt) names no Claude/anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot agent and does not disallow the /es/en/o/ category paths, so extraction proceeded. TREE: taken from the site's own server-rendered English mega-menu on https://kavehome.com/es/en/ (Products > Outdoor and Products > Furniture are the only furniture-bearing branches; Decoration, Soft furnishings, Lighting, Kitchenware, Customisable collections, Selected Collection, Kave Gallery and the Rooms menu were each inspected and add no furniture nodes - the Rooms menu only links room hub pages r/living-room, r/bedroom, r/office etc. that re-use the same category slugs). It was then cross-checked against https://kavehome.com/es/en/categories-sitemap.xml (270 category URLs), which surfaced the deeper leaves that the mega-menu hides behind hub pages. Hub pages that the menu points at (r/sofas-by-seats, r/tv-stand-sideboards, r/bookshelf-shelves, r/storage-furniture, r/hallway-furniture-console-tables-shoe-storage, r/coat-racks-hangers, o/storage-units, o/beds, o/chairs, o/garden-chairs, o/baby-furniture, o/kids) were opened in the tab and their on-page sub-category chips read, which is how the parent/child mapping was established; those hub pages are emitted as grouping rows and their children as leaves per the deepest-URL rule. QTY: every leaf number is the site's own rendered listing header ('N products'). The header is driven by the Algolia InstantSearch payload that Kave Home embeds server-side in each category page's Next.js RSC stream (appId EQ79XLPIU7, index product_es_en). This was validated by loading o/dining-tables in the tab and reading the rendered header '246 products' against the same page's nbHits=246, and re-checked the same way on o/outdoor-bar-chairs (96), o/storage-units (215) and r/bookshelf-shelves (70) - the two sources agreed every time. Exhaustion check on every row: hitsPerPage is a stable 96 and ceil(nbHits/96)==nbPages held for all rows. Three nodes (o/poufs, o/garden-pouffes, o/garden-armchairs-pouffes) do not expose the payload in their server HTML, so their counts were read directly off the rendered header in the tab instead. Counts differ between category and category (897 for the outdoor department, 2 for garden rocking chairs), so no site-wide-constant artefact; none is a round display cap. OVERLAP: as in the earlier Home-Decor pass, a Kave product is tagged into several nodes, so children routinely out-sum their parent (Sofas 780 vs 2/3/4/5-seater+corner+modular; Baby & Kids furniture 39 vs children summing 45). Parents are emitted as grouping rows with no qty, so the mismatch does not propagate. EXCLUDED and why: Lighting, Decoration, Soft furnishings and Kitchenware branches entirely (other projects); o/bathroom-countertops (15) - opened it, the tiles are countertop washbasins/basins, i.e. bathroom fixtures; o/bathroom-mirrors and o/bathroom-accessories (mirrors / bathroom hardware); o/hangers (25, 'Coat hangers and hooks') and o/hangers-rails-kids (15) - opened the latter, tiles are wall hooks, not furniture; o/baskets, o/laundry-baskets, o/kids-rugs, o/floor-cushions (standalone storage / textiles); o/mattresses2, o/bed-covers-headboards-and-accessories, o/bed-pillows, o/mattress-toppers (bedding); the two identically named 'Bed bases' nodes o/bed-bases (13) and o/bed-bases-b (7) plus o/slatted-bed-bases (2) and o/legs-bed-bases - bed bases and bed-base legs are excluded as bed support/parts, and the duplicate naming made a clean single row impossible; o/cleaning-maintenance, o/material-samples, o/accessories (sofa accessories), o/chairs-accessories, o/garden-furniture-covers (furniture care/parts/covers); o/customized, o/customisable-armchairs and o/collections-upholstered-leather (customisation and material filter pages); the whole 'Customisable collections' menu branch (c/anarela, c/blok, ... - brand collections); all s/ selections, e/ editorials, sale-*, seasonal-deal-* and *-black-friday slugs; o/storage-units (215, h1 literally 'Furniture') and o/outdoor-stools-benches (52 = outdoor-stools 45 + garden-benches 7) as catch-all/aggregate rollups whose children are all captured individually. EMPTY NODES: o/childrens-tables-and-desks and o/bookshelves-and-bookcases are live mega-menu items but both return nbHits=0, so they are not emitted; o/single-sofa-beds is likewise 0 and omitted. FLAGGED: o/shelves (wall shelves filed under the Furniture department), o/folding-chairs and o/garden-rocking-chairs (real listings present only in the sitemap, not reachable from the nav), and o/pouffes-floor-cushions (mixed kids node containing 2 floor cushions).
